key_findings: Multi-session 40 Hz tFUS increased GAD67 and PV immunoreactivity and shifted E/I balance toward inhibition in a sickle cell disease pain mouse model.
Optogenetic PV activation mimicked tFUS EEG effects whereas SST activation decreased the aperiodic exponent; no tissue damage was found.
